name: Graduate Programs in Bioscience

sources.label: Central application, fee and waiver requirements

detailsNote: Central official application requirements available. Consortium-specific deadline, GRE policy, admission model and additional requirements could not be confirmed because program admissions pages were unavailable.
summary: A consortium of 10 home areas and affiliated PhD programs in the life and biomedical sciences.

english.toefl: 87 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 on or after January 21, 2026
english.note: University admission minima; departments may require higher scores. Scores valid for two years at submission. Prior degree from an accredited institution in the US or a country where English is the sole instructional language under WHED may exempt testing. MyBest TOEFL not accepted.

applicationFee.note: $135 for US citizens/permanent residents; $155 for others. Waivers offered for listed preparation programs, qualifying financial need and benefits. International applicants should confirm eligibility; need-based routes require qualifying California aid or US tax documentation.

requirements.note: Central regular admission GPA expectation is B (3.0/4.0) or equivalent; departments may request a discretionary exception. International records must meet degree-equivalence rules; official records and authorized English translations are required after admission. GRE and recommendation count depend on the selected major/home area; confirm directly. The unavailable consortium pages may list additional documents.

international.note: University policy accepts international applications; confirm home-area requirements and restrictions.
